json.evidence: Photos 1-15 show only the exterior of a large multi-story brick institutional building: facades, windows, the main entrance with a stone portico and staircase (photos 3-6, 12-14), a steel ring sculpture or bike rack in the gravel courtyard (photos 1, 2, 7, 9-11), a smaller annex with a glass entry (photo 8), and a wide courtyard view (photo 15). No photo shows an electrical panel, breaker, meter, disconnect, or service equipment. The only mechanical item visible is a louvered grille beside the entrance stairs (photos 6, 15), and it cannot be identified as electrical equipment.
json.notes: No electrical service equipment is visible, so the panel layout cannot be assessed. The building also appears to be a large commercial or institutional property rather than a single-family home. Multiple mains are not proven, and neither is a single main.
